title: Computer action IR and model adapters
objective: Define the provider-neutral ComputerActionProposal carrying untrusted proposal data only, with adapters normalizing provider syntax only and never granting authority. Implement the UI-TARS adapter behind the canonical IR only. Prove malformed, oversized, truncated, ambiguous, unknown, authority-smuggling, NaN, infinite, overflow, forged-identity, and direct-backend inputs fail closed, with fuzz, property, and differential tests where valuable.

include: canonical ComputerActionProposal vocabulary as untrusted proposal data only
adapter syntax normalization with no authority grant
UI-TARS adapter behind the canonical IR only
malformed, oversized, truncated, ambiguous, unknown, and authority-smuggling input denial
NaN, infinity, overflow, forged-identity, and direct-backend denial
fuzz, property, and differential tests where valuable
exclude: new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority
